tool.name: RADAR-PD Diagnostic: Facility Access
tool.description: report read-only SNS/HFIR path visibility and permissions
tool.command: touch '$report' '$console_output' && trap "chmod a+r '$report' '$console_output' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true" EXIT && set -euo pipefail && export RADAR_PROBE_FACILITY='$facility_root' && export RADAR_PROBE_INSTRUMENT='$instrument' && export RADAR_PROBE_IPTS='$ipts' && export RADAR_PROBE_RELATIVE='$relative_path' && export RADAR_PROBE_REPORT='$report' && python -c 'import json, os, re; from pathlib import Path; facility=os.environ["RADAR_PROBE_FACILITY"]; instrument=os.environ["RADAR_PROBE_INSTRUMENT"].strip().upper(); ipts_raw=os.environ["RADAR_PROBE_IPTS"].strip(); match=re.fullmatch(r"IPTS[-_ ]?(\d+)", ipts_raw, re.IGNORECASE); assert facility in {"/SNS", "/HFIR"}, "invalid facility root"; assert re.fullmatch(r"[A-Z0-9_-]+", instrument), "invalid instrument"; assert match, "invalid IPTS"; ipts=f"IPTS-{match.group(1)}"; relative=Path(os.environ["RADAR_PROBE_RELATIVE"].strip() or "."); assert not relative.is_absolute() and ".." not in relative.parts, "path must remain inside IPTS"; base=(Path(facility)/instrument/ipts).resolve(strict=False); target=(base/relative).resolve(strict=False); target.relative_to(base); entries=sorted([{"name": item.name, "kind": "directory" if item.is_dir() else "file", "size": item.stat().st_size if item.is_file() else None} for item in target.iterdir()], key=lambda item: item["name"].lower())[:100] if target.is_dir() else []; sample_len=len(target.open("rb").read(64)) if target.is_file() else None; result={"facility_root": facility, "instrument": instrument, "ipts": ipts, "base": str(base), "relative_path": str(relative), "target": str(target), "exists": target.exists(), "is_directory": target.is_dir(), "is_file": target.is_file(), "readable": os.access(target, os.R_OK), "writable": os.access(target, os.W_OK), "searchable": os.access(target, os.X_OK), "entries": entries, "list_probe": "ok" if target.is_dir() else None, "read_probe": {"status": "ok", "bytes_read": sample_len, "size": target.stat().st_size} if target.is_file() else None}; payload=json.dumps(result, indent=2)+"\n"; Path(os.environ["RADAR_PROBE_REPORT"]).write_text(payload, encoding="utf-8"); print(payload, end="")' > '$console_output' 2>&1

param.name: relative_path
param.label: Path inside the IPTS
param.help: Leave empty to inspect the IPTS root. Absolute paths and parent traversal are rejected.

tool.help: This prototype diagnostic is read-only. It reports whether an SNS or HFIR path exists in the NDIP batch container, whether a directory can be listed, whether a file can be opened, and the effective read/write/search permission flags. It never creates, changes, or deletes facility data.
